9.6                                  A targeted alternative is a new study
A natural response is to offer the enhancement only to households likely to withdraw external
funds. That may reduce repricing cost, but it changes the intervention and target population.
A withdrawal-risk model predicts which customers leave under historical practice. It does not
necessarily predict whose withdrawal is preventable by the offer. High-risk customers may be
insensitive to price; low-risk customers may accept a subsidy without changing their behavior.
   The appropriate targeting comparison uses conditional effects on the group funding account
and evaluates the whole targeting rule on held-out or randomized data. It includes contact costs,
take-up, rate duration and customer constraints. The existing static example demonstrates
why a known positive average effect does not establish that one targeted policy beats another
at the declared simultaneous confidence level.
   For repeat offers, the problem becomes longitudinal. A first offer changes balances and
may teach customers to wait for future offers. Selection for the next offer then depends on a
variable affected by the first. The sequential methods in Chapter 4 are needed to compare
sustained strategies. A one-period uplift score should not be repeated indefinitely under an
assumption of unchanged effects.


9.7                                  What can transfer from the literature
Drechsler et al. (2017) supports a mechanism linking market power, deposit pricing and
transmission, with specific within-bank and local comparisons. Basten and Juelsrud (2026)
investigates relationship stickiness and cross-selling using mover and prior-location variation.
Both suggest heterogeneity worth measuring. Neither establishes that a bank’s current
customers share the same elasticities, product alternatives or information.
   Refinancing evidence adds a complementary lesson. In Agarwal et al. (2020), eligibility for
HARP provides a policy comparison; the paper distinguishes a program effect from the selected
experience of borrowers who refinance and studies competitive frictions in pass-through. This
is analogous to keeping an assigned retention offer distinct from acceptance. Beraja et al.
(2019) further explains why local responses do not settle aggregate policy effects. A bank-wide
price change can alter competitor behavior and internal funding substitution beyond the local
partial-equilibrium study.
                      The platform should consequently store an evidence-transfer statement: which mechanism
56                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


or design comes from the paper, which coefficient is estimated on owned data, and which
equilibrium or stability assumptions remain scenario inputs. Literature informs construction
without becoming an unexamined parameter database.


9.8     The reusable application and acceptance test
The deposit application exports a study specification, reconstructed cohort, balance/flow/con-
tribution definitions, cohort-time effects, covariance, target weights, trend sensitivity and a
funding report. A FinMarketing consumer can use the supported causal response in its own
financial workflow if the population, intervention and account match. A treasury consumer
can use the funding contrast while retaining its transfer-price and liquidity assumptions.
   Bank acceptance would require reconciliation to authoritative balances and interest, verified
external-versus-internal flows, a defensible rollout or experimental design, explicit spillover
analysis, adequate independent branches and outcome maturity. The equivalent-task com-
parator is a bank economist building the same study with existing panel software and the
warehouse. The product earns its role if it reconstructs and updates that study more reliably
and cheaply while preserving the same scientific answer, including this kind of unfavorable
result.
Chapter 10

Repeated collections decisions and
policy value

10.1      Define assistance before optimizing it
Collections is a natural longitudinal application because an action changes the state that
determines later action. A payment reminder, temporary forbearance and a contractual
restructuring are different interventions. They affect cash timing, costs, eligibility and customer
outcomes differently. The initial product should evaluate a small set of operationally defined
assistance strategies, with ordinary servicing as the comparator, before attempting unrestricted
policy optimization.
   The economic owner matters. A servicer, a loan owner and a purchaser of distressed debt
receive different cash flows. The study preserves the original eligible cohort, includes assistance
delivery costs and defines the remaining claim at the horizon. It reports customer outcomes
separately, such as persistent hardship or repeated delinquency, rather than assuming that
bank contribution fully represents them.
   The following complete synthetic study isolates the observed-history case. The controlled
hidden-state study in Chapter 7 then shows what changes when relevant information is
hidden from the analyst. Neither study represents a named bank’s customers or treatment
effectiveness.


10.2      A three-state decision process
The observed pre-action state is St ∈ {0, 1, 2}, representing current, moderate stress and severe
stress. Initial proportions are (0.6, 0.3, 0.1). Extra assistance is feasible only in states one and
two. The historical action-one probabilities are (0, 0.35, 0.60). These are known randomized
probabilities conditional on the observed state; there is no hidden action confounding in this
experiment.
  The transition matrices are
                                                                       
                            .88 .10 .02                    .88 .10 .02
                      P0 = .30 .50 .20 ,           P1 = .50 .40 .10 .
                                                                   
                            .08 .22 .70                    .18 .42 .40

The first row for action one is not used because assistance is infeasible there. The process has
eight decisions and monthly discount γ = 0.99. Contribution associated with the next state

                                                57
58                                                                                Causal analysis for a universal bank


is (20, −10, −160) dollars, less USD 12 for each assistance action. These are signed monthly
contribution increments, not a repeated write-off of the same principal. A terminal adjustment
of USD −100 in severe stress represents the remaining account beyond the eight-month cash
window.
  This law lets assistance improve future states while costing money today. It also creates
practical support difficulties: the probability of following a deterministic strategy over all eight
dates can be small even though each feasible action has positive probability at every state.
The known finite Markov law gives an exact policy-value reference without requiring Monte
Carlo approximation of truth.


10.3        Policies, training information and exact evaluation
Three fixed policies are declared before fitting: no extra assistance, assistance only in severe
stress, and assistance in all eligible states. They use observable information and respect the
same feasible action set. The study draws 3,000 training trajectories and 8,000 independent
evaluation trajectories. Training data estimate transition rows by observed counts with a
one-half pseudocount in each next-state category.
     For each target policy π, backward recursion under the fitted transition law gives
                              Pba (s, s′ ){r(s′ ) + γ Vbt+1 (s′ )} − 12a,
                         X                                                                X
          Q
          b t (s, a) =                                                        Vbt (s) =       π(a | s)Q
                                                                                                      b t (s, a).
                         s′                                                               a

The terminal condition is the declared remaining account. Repeating the recursion with the
generating transition law gives the exact reference value, available only to the evaluator. The
fitted policy scores never consume generated latent variables or future information unavailable
at the relevant decision.
   The direct method averages Vb0 (S0 ) over evaluation initial states. Stepwise importance
sampling reweights each dated reward by the full product of target-to-behavior action ratios
through that date. Sequential DR adds cumulative-ratio Bellman residuals to the direct
prediction. All three target the same discounted contribution and terminal account. This
alignment is essential for a fair comparison.

Table 10.1: Eight-decision fixed-policy values in dollars per original eligible customer. Final
ESS describes concentration of final trajectory weights; it is not the independent sample size
of every dated score.

  The direct estimates depend entirely on the fitted transition law. Importance sampling
uses known logging and remains highly variable on rare complete paths. DR corrects fitted
continuation errors but cannot remove all realized transition and reward uncertainty. Its
empirical value need not lie between the other two estimates.


10.4        A plausible shortcut estimates the wrong law
Suppose the analyst uses only the current-action ratio at each date. This changes the
distribution of the action conditional on the historical incoming state, but leaves that incoming
10.5. Evaluate contrasts with their covariance                                                59


state distributed under historical practice. Earlier assistance has already changed who reaches
severe stress. The shortcut therefore does not evaluate a sustained target policy.
   For the all-eligible strategy in this run, that current-ratio calculation gives approximately
USD −36.79, compared with exact value USD −2.34. For no extra assistance it gives about
USD −82.67, compared with exact value USD −139.58. The error is not fixed by a larger
evaluation sample: it is a mismatch between the reweighted distribution and the requested
intervention. A marginalized state-ratio estimator would need the target- to-behavior state
occupancy ratio as well as the action ratio.
  The software consequence is a required weight-scope declaration. “Propensity-weighted” is
too vague. A result should distinguish current-action, full-history, marginal occupancy and
censoring weights, with their target and normalization. A consumer can then reject a score
that lacks the history correction required by its policy contrast.


10.5      Evaluate contrasts with their covariance
The practical question is the incremental contribution relative to the incumbent. Compute both
policy scores on each evaluation trajectory and form their difference. The standard error of the
mean uses the variance of this paired difference, preserving covariance from shared customers.
There are two prespecified comparisons against no extra assistance; Bonferroni-adjusted normal
intervals give a conservative simultaneous approximation for that family.

             Policy versus no extra True USD DR difference Simultaneous interval
             Severe state only            81.32        78.01         [44.58, 111.44]
             All eligible                137.24       139.26        [103.83, 174.69]

Table 10.2: Prespecified contrasts using paired DR scores. These intervals condition on the
training fits and on the synthetic complete-trajectory law.

  The account and intervention are deliberately simple enough to reconstruct. For a bank
implementation, inference must also handle estimated observation probabilities, household or
regional clustering, delayed losses and policy selection. The positive synthetic comparisons
cannot be treated as measured collections benefit for the investment case.


10.6      Double robustness and interval reliability differ
The repeated experiment uses 160 independent datasets, each with 600 training and 2,000
evaluation trajectories. It evaluates the all-eligible policy under four nuisance specifications:
fitted transition values and true logging; zero interior action values and true logging; exact
action values and a wrong logging model assigning probability 0.5 in eligible states; and both
the zero action values and wrong logging.
   The terminal account is correct in all four cases. The first two illustrate the protection
of known assignment; the third isolates the correct-value route; the fourth has no double-
robustness protection. The generating law and declared policies remain fixed across repetitions,
while the independent datasets vary. No favorable subset of repetitions is selected.
   The zero-value/true-logging case has mean protection but coverage well below 95% in this
finite experiment. Highly variable path weights make a normal approximation unreliable at
this sample size. Even the exact-value case does not guarantee nominal finite-sample coverage.
The wrong-both case happens to have modest average bias under this particular law; that is
60                                                              Causal analysis for a universal bank


                    Specification           Bias (USD) RMSE 95% coverage
                    DR                           0.15   17.33            0.938
                    Wrong Q; true logging        0.71   18.28            0.869
                    True Q; wrong logging        0.55   10.72            0.912
                    Both wrong                   1.41   12.67            0.856

Table 10.3: Repeated-sample error and nominal normal-interval coverage for all-eligible policy
value. Monte Carlo standard errors for coverage range from about 0.019 to 0.028 and are
retained in the result file.

not evidence of a new robustness property. A misspecified estimator can perform tolerably
under one mechanism and fail under another.
   The product recommendation is therefore to report weight concentration, extreme score
contributions, horizon sensitivity and repeated-sample calibration on relevant synthetic mech-
anisms before selecting an interval method. Weight truncation can improve stability while
introducing bias; any chosen threshold is part of the estimator. A shorter feasible policy com-
parison or a prospective experiment may be more informative than a nominally sophisticated
long-horizon estimate.


10.7       What partial observation adds to this study

Observed stress states in the present experiment are sufficient for the transition and action
laws. Real collections staff may observe private conversation details, perceived ability to pay
or impending income events. If those signals also affect action assignment and outcomes, the
recorded-history exchangeability used here fails.
   Chapter 7 constructs that alternative explicitly. Signals imperfectly measure a hidden state,
and historical assistance depends on that state. A joint action–observation likelihood improves
recovery under the stated parametric environment but retains substantial policy uncertainty.
Proximal and instrumental-variable OPE offer other routes under different measurements
and restrictions (Tennenholtz et al., 2020; Bennett and Kallus, 2023; Xu et al., 2023). A
bank cannot choose among those routes solely by whichever model gives the largest estimated
recovery gain.
   The first bank pilot should therefore investigate the action log alongside the outcome data.
It must document which staff information was available, which variables were recorded before
decisions, how discretion operated, and whether an existing randomized or quasi-experimental
variation can anchor transition effects. That work determines whether the module returns an
identified policy contrast, a conditional scenario or a bounded effect.


10.8       A deployable study application, before an automated
           policy

The standalone collections workbench would display complete eligible trajectories, action and
observation clocks, fitted continuation values, support diagnostics, fixed-policy comparisons
and customer-outcome constraints. It would retain the original cohort after default, sale or
closure and explain how each event enters the economic account. A model developer can
investigate latent dynamics without promoting a policy.
     A downstream application can consume the evidence package to compare approved strategies.
10.8. A deployable study application, before an automated policy                          61


Promotion to operational decision making additionally requires current permissions, execution
capability, customer protection, prospective or otherwise adequate value evidence and ongoing
monitoring. Those are implementation obligations of the proposed bank product, not claims
established by the present synthetic studies.
Chapter 11

Credit supply, refinancing and
macro transmission

11.1     A group-level causal product needs several levels of anal-
         ysis
Retail treatment effects do not exhaust the questions of a universal bank. The institution
must understand how funding conditions change credit supply, how borrowers substitute
between lenders, and how mortgage refinancing transmits policy to household cash flow. Those
questions use bank-firm networks, market-level variation and aggregate time series. They
also expose why the product cannot apply one customer-level identification strategy to every
business problem.
   Three published designs illustrate complementary information. The liquidity shock study
of Mian and Khwaja (2006) compares differently affected banks lending to the same firm.
Agarwal et al. (2020) uses exposure to a refinancing program to distinguish policy effects
from borrowers’ selected refinancing choices. Benetton (2021) estimates mortgage demand
and lender behavior to study market-wide regulation. Each makes additional claims that
require additional assumptions as the analysis moves from local variation toward aggregate
counterfactuals.


11.2     Separating loan supply from borrower demand
Let ∆Lf b be loan growth for firm f at bank b, and let Zb measure an externally induced
funding shock. A simple model is

                                    ∆Lf b = αf + βZb + ϵf b .                             (11.1)

The firm effect absorbs its common change in demand across lenders. For firms with several
bank relationships, subtracting the within-firm mean gives

                          ∆Lf b − ∆Lf · = β(Zb − Z̄f · ) + (ϵf b − ϵ̄f · ).

Identification comes from different lender shocks facing the same borrower, under the restriction
that their residual relationship-specific demand components do not co-vary with those shocks.
A firm’s general investment opportunity can correlate with the shocks of its chosen banks and
still be removed; a bank-specific export-credit need correlated with the funding shock may
remain a confounder.

                                                 62
11.3. An executed matched-lender study                                                        63


   The distinction is explicit in the archived 2006 paper (Mian and Khwaja, 2006, Section
III.B, equation 5). It also notes the importance of unanticipated shocks and the restriction to
multiple-bank borrowers. The later question of total firm borrowing cannot simply insert the
same firm effect after aggregating to one firm-level observation. Borrower substitution and
aggregate real effects need additional evidence.


11.3     An executed matched-lender study
The synthetic construction has 600 firms, 24 banks and three relationships per firm. Bank
shocks Zb and firm demand terms Uf are initially independent standard normals. Relationship
selection favors banks with similar shock exposure through probabilities proportional to
exp(0.65Uf Zb ). This produces correlation between a firm’s demand and its observed lenders’
shocks. Generated loan growth is

                              ∆Lf b = 2 − 3Zb + 4Uf + ηb + εf b ,                         (11.2)

with bank noise standard deviation 0.45 and relationship noise standard deviation 1.5. Units
are percentage points of loan growth per unit funding shock. The true supply coefficient is −3
by construction.
   Pooled regression leaves selected borrower demand in the error. Firm demeaning removes
the common 4Uf term. The study estimates both on the same 1,800 relationships. The within
estimator’s illustrative interval clusters residual score contributions by bank and uses a t23
critical value. There are 24 independent bank shocks, not 1,800 independent policy shocks.
The demonstration is one sample under the stipulated law; it does not qualify few-cluster
inference for arbitrary lending networks.

                          Method              Coefficient   95% interval
                          Generating effect       -3.000                –
                          Pooled                  -1.080                –
                          Borrower effects        -2.923 [-3.027, -2.819]

Table 11.1: Synthetic matched-bank loan-growth comparison. Relationship selection biases
the pooled association, while borrower effects recover the stipulated supply coefficient much
more closely.

   The estimate changes from approximately −1.08 pooled to −2.92 with borrower effects. The
difference is economically substantial. It arises because the design compares lenders serving
the same borrower, rather than because fixed effects are a universal solution to endogeneity.
If relationship-specific demand were correlated with Zb , the within estimator could remain
biased. If all a firm’s lenders had identical exposure, that firm would contribute no within-firm
identifying variation.


11.4     What the bank would need to observe
A single bank sees its own lending, not necessarily the same firm’s other relationships. It may
need an appropriately permitted credit registry, syndicated-loan dataset or borrower-supplied
exposure record to implement this design. A model for outside borrowing does not substitute
for those measurements without new assumptions. Entity resolution must preserve legal
borrower, consolidated group, facility and lender roles; several facilities at one bank do not
create several independent lender shocks.
64                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


   The source snapshot must retain pre-shock relationships to avoid conditioning on post-shock
survival or new borrowing. Committed lines, drawn balances, new originations, prices and
collateral changes are different outcomes. A borrower drawing an existing commitment during
a shock can increase observed balances while the bank tightens new credit. The product
therefore requires an outcome type before fitting the panel.
   For a group credit committee, the first report can show the identified relative supply
response and its supported borrower population. A second scenario may translate loan changes
into funding, margin and capital requirements. That translation needs the contract account,
maturities, loss assumptions and borrower substitution. The platform should preserve the first
empirical result even if the second remains model-dependent.



11.5     Refinancing: eligibility, take-up and ownership

Refinancing illustrates another frequent causal mistake: comparing borrowers who refinance
with those who do not. Refinancing choices respond to attention, creditworthiness, equity,
expected mobility and competing offers. Those factors can also predict later spending and
default. An observed post-refinancing improvement does not by itself estimate the effect of an
offer or policy that induces refinancing.
   Agarwal et al. (2020) uses HARP eligibility to define treatment exposure, with conforming
high-LTV loans and a comparison group of observationally similar non-agency loans. The
paper examines pre-program comparisons, refinancing, borrower savings and broader spending
outcomes, and studies competitive frictions in pass-through. The appropriate product lesson
is the separation of program exposure, take-up and downstream outcomes. Its design and
estimates depend on that institutional setting and should not be transplanted unchanged to a
new bank’s retention program.
   The bank also needs an ownership account. A lower mortgage rate can improve the house-
hold’s cash flow while reducing the value of a mortgage asset held by the group. Origination
or servicing fees may accrue to a different entity. Paying off an old claim and originating a
replacement cannot be valued by adding the new loan’s gross interest while ignoring the old
asset, funding and principal movements. The causal module supplies a supported behavioral
contrast; the mortgage account supplies the signed cash and continuation value for each owner.
   A practical study can define assigned refinancing assistance as treatment, measure application,
offer, acceptance and closing as separate stages, and value the original eligible cohort. Failed
delivery and non-take-up remain in an intention-to-treat analysis. A complier effect or
mechanism analysis needs additional assumptions. Outcome maturity can be long even when
take-up is observed quickly, which affects both study power and the product investment
calendar.



11.6     Why equilibrium counterfactuals need more structure

A broad change in capital requirements or a group-wide mortgage price policy can alter
competitor prices, market shares and loan amounts. Benetton (2021) models borrowers’
discrete product choice and continuous loan demand, together with multiproduct lender
pricing. It uses variation in predetermined risk-weighted capital requirements as cost shifters
and separates lender and product variation. This construction allows equilibrium questions
beyond a local reduced-form effect, under the demand, supply, exclusion and behavioral
restrictions of that model.
11.7. Treasury transmission and the shock catalogue                                             65


   For the proposed platform, this is a reason to expose a structural extension interface. A fitted
local response may be an input or a validation target for a structural model, but it does not
determine the entire market counterfactual. Supply response, outside options and competitive
conduct remain separate parameters or assumptions. Good market-share prediction under the
incumbent is informative about fit and incomplete evidence about an unprecedented policy
intervention.
   Beraja et al. (2019) makes the aggregation issue particularly relevant to monetary transmis-
sion: regional variation can reveal heterogeneous responses while common aggregate effects
cancel from the comparison. Adding local coefficients does not recover what was differenced out.
A group-level report should distinguish directly identified local effects, reweighted population
effects and equilibrium model scenarios.


11.7      Treasury transmission and the shock catalogue
The time-series workspace should preserve a catalogue of candidate shocks: their economic
definition, observation timestamp, normalization, source, instrument construction and main-
tained exclusion restrictions. A market rate change, a policy-announcement surprise and a
bank-specific liquidity shock are different objects. A discovered lead-lag relation can suggest a
candidate mechanism, but it does not turn an ordinary residual into an identified structural
shock.
   For a selected shock, local projections and structural VARs can be challengers with a common
outcome, horizon and normalization. The external- instrument argument in Stock and Watson
(2018) requires the relevant dynamic exclusions; Jordà and Taylor (2024) explains estimation
and inference alternatives. The report should show response covariance, weak-instrument
diagnostics, regime sensitivity and the difference between a shock response and a sustained
policy path. Few independent macro episodes remain a limitation even in a bank with billions
of transaction records.


11.8      What the shared product contributes
These applications share temporal reconstruction, economic entity roles, source lineage, score
covariance and evidence export. They retain distinct identification routes: matched borrowers
for supply, policy eligibility for refinancing, structural demand and supply for equilibrium, and
external shock restrictions for macro transmission. This is a stronger reusable product than a
collection of regressions with common plotting defaults.
   MacroFinance can consume a supported shock or empirical response while retaining its
structural equilibrium assumptions. SMEwallet can consume an observed or identified relation-
ship response while preserving uncertainty about outside borrowing. FinMarketing can use
an eligible-cohort response in a compatible mortgage or relationship account. The proposal
specifies those exchanges; it does not certify current adapters or endorse a copied historical
repository milestone as a current qualification.
           Part IV

Data, software and a reusable
           product




              66
Chapter 12

Automatic organization of banking
data

12.1     Organize around decisions

The product needs more than an automated feature table. It needs an account of which
entity could receive which action, what was known when, what actually happened, and which
outcomes belong to that decision. The basic hierarchy is legal entity, customer or firm,
household or connected group, account, product, decision episode and event. Relationships
can change over time and must be versioned.
  Separate four graphs. The enterprise metadata graph describes datasets, fields, ownership
and business terms. The entity graph links people, households, firms and accounts with
uncertainty. The lineage graph records transformations and versions. The causal graph
represents intervention assumptions. Cross-references between them are valuable; merging
their edge semantics is a scientific error.



12.2     The event and availability clocks

Every event needs occurrence time, economic effective time, system recording time and the
time it became available to the relevant decision process. These need not coincide. A backdated
arrears correction or revised income field may describe the past while being unavailable at the
past decision. Retrospective warehouse completeness can therefore create prospective leakage.
  For a feature used at decision d, require

                              tavailable (f ) ≤ td ,        tevent (f ) ≤ td ,              (12.1)

for historical measurements, together with a valid entity mapping and permission context. An
explicitly known future contractual schedule is a different feature class and needs its own rule.
For a derived feature, availability is no earlier than the latest input availability and its actual
publication to the decision system. An event-time join alone is insufficient.
   Retain UTC instants, original time zones and applicable business calendars. A statement
date, settlement date and decision timestamp have different semantics. Late-arriving data
should produce a new analysis snapshot while preserving the original replay. Restating an old
feature in place destroys the evidence needed to reconstruct the historical decision.

                                                       67
68                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


12.3     A proposed organization pipeline
Connectors first inventory schemas and permitted metadata, profile fields, and propose types,
units and entity keys. Statistical matching and language models may suggest mappings to a
banking glossary. Confidence scores prioritize human review; they do not certify that a column
means assigned treatment, accepted offer or available information.
   Next, identity resolution produces deterministic links where authoritative keys exist and
probabilistic links otherwise. A false household merge can create apparent interference; a missed
merge can leak information across folds. Preserve match probabilities, link provenance and
alternative plausible matches. Splink is a candidate linkage component (moj-analytical-services
contributors, 2026); downstream causal sensitivity remains the platform’s responsibility.
   The event builder normalizes money, calendars, action codes and state transitions. It retains
raw units and conversion policies, and validates stock-flow identities. An account-month table
should distinguish a true zero, a structurally inapplicable value, a missing measurement and
a value not yet available. The trajectory builder then assembles eligibility, actions, receipts,
outcomes and censoring on the declared decision clock.
   Finally, the study compiler checks temporal order, independent-unit keys, population support
and the compatibility of the requested estimand with the available design. It outputs a frozen
cohort manifest and a list of unresolved assumptions. It cannot infer conditional exchangeability
from schema quality.


12.4     Treatment and outcome provenance
An action record should contain assignment probability where known, policy version, eligibility
rule, decision time, assigned treatment, delivery, receipt and override reason. Overrides and
relationship-manager information can be part of the assignment mechanism. Their absence is
a model issue, not simply a missing-data nuisance.
   For financial outcomes, use a component ledger. Deposit funding benefit, interest expense,
servicing cost, credit loss and terminal value each have one owner, a valuation date and a
scenario definition. Internal transfers must reconcile across products. A group effect aggregates
compatible components; it should not add product-level gains that count the same customer
movement twice.
  Terminal values need explicit continuation assumptions. A twelve-month experiment cannot
nonparametrically identify lifetime value without further information. Distinguish observed-
period contribution from modeled continuation. Discount curves and funds-transfer prices are
inputs with provenance and sensitivity ranges.


12.5     Corruption and imputation uncertainty
Missingness and measurement errors often depend on customer behavior: unobserved com-
petitor balances, selectively requested income documents, unlogged calls and sold loans are
examples. Generic predictive imputation does not establish causal recovery. Corruption-aware
theory can use approximate repeated measurements and low-rank structure (Agarwal and
Singh, 2022); those restrictions must be justified for each dataset.
   The integration with a data-recovery system should transmit masks, measurement models,
uncertainty draws and recovery assumptions. Imputation must occur inside the appropriate
training partitions when fitted preprocessing could leak evaluation information. Outcomes
12.6. Reuse the bank’s data foundations                                                         69


may appropriately enter a congenial statistical imputation model for some estimands, but such
use must never make unavailable outcomes appear as operational policy inputs. The two roles
require separate datasets and explicit contracts.
  Combining estimates across recovery draws needs within- and between-draw uncertainty. A
simple multiple-imputation formula is appropriate only under its assumptions and analysis
compatibility. Joint models or sensitivity sets may be necessary. A single completed table
with no missingness record conceals a material source of uncertainty.


12.6      Reuse the bank’s data foundations

DataHub and OpenMetadata provide catalog, ownership and lineage capabilities (datahub-
project contributors, 2026; open-metadata contributors, 2026). OpenLineage records runtime
job and dataset relationships (OpenLineage contributors, 2026). Feast provides historical/online
feature access and time-travel retrieval (feast-dev contributors, 2026); the inspected API
includes a created-timestamp filtering option. Availability semantics still require verification
of the chosen backend and source timestamps. Pandera can enforce dataframe contracts
(unionai-oss contributors, 2026).
  The bank should integrate its existing catalog and feature infrastructure. The causal
product adds study-specific semantics: intervention versions, decision information, estimands,
dependence, graph assumptions and evidence. It should not require the group to replace a
working enterprise catalog.


12.7      Data architecture as accountable evidence

BCBS239 emphasizes integrated taxonomies, identifiers, ownership and robust reconciliation,
without requiring one physical data model (Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, 2013).
These principles support the proposed semantic layer, but a causal product’s conformity
to them is not established by this proposal. Production acceptance needs actual lineage
completeness, reconciliation and recovery tests on the bank’s systems.
   Useful automation therefore makes a reviewable proposal, detects inconsistencies and
produces reproducible transformations. Consequential semantic assertions remain attributable
to a responsible owner. The user interface should show the unresolved business question in
ordinary language, such as whether the recorded offer denotes assignment or acceptance, rather
than exposing irrelevant implementation internals.


12.8      A canonical model that preserves native accounts

The common data model should standardize identities and relationships while leaving native
financial objects intact. A household can own several accounts; a company can be borrower
on a facility and guarantor on another; a booking entity can own a claim serviced elsewhere.
Collapsing these roles into one “customer ID” creates ambiguity in assignment, interference
and financial ownership. The entity graph needs typed roles with validity intervals and the
source of each link.
  At the center is a decision episode: actor, subject, eligible actions, decision time, information
snapshot and policy version. Assignment, dispatch, receipt, acceptance and settlement are
subsequent linked events. A failed dispatch can incur cost without receipt; acceptance can
70                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


occur after several contacts; settlement can be corrected later. A single binary “treated” field
cannot faithfully represent all these stages.
  Outcome components refer back to the original episode and economic owner. They carry
currency, sign convention, economic date, available date and claim or account identifier. The
same customer transfer can generate two product entries but only one group movement.
Reconciliation keys allow the group account to cancel internal entries without erasing their
product- level operational meaning.
   This model should support views for customer trajectories, branch panels, bank-firm
relationships and aggregate series. A view declares its aggregation weights and denominator.
An average per active account differs from a total per original eligible household, particularly
when the policy changes closure or new account opening. The platform must retain the
denominator as a first-class object.


12.9       Revision selection precedes feature-window selection
For one decision, first identify versions that were available by its timestamp. Among those,
select the authoritative revision of each economic event. Only then apply the feature’s
economic-time window and void status. Reversing those steps can resurrect an obsolete event.
  The supplied temporal component exercises four records. A credit of USD 100 becomes
available on 3 January and is revised to USD 60 on 10 January. A USD 30 event dated 4
January arrives on 12 January. A USD 20 event initially dated 5 January is revised on 10
January to an economic date of 1 February. A USD 40 event is voided on 10 January. For a
complete-feed thirty-day lookback, the correct totals are USD 160 at the 8 January decision
and USD 90 at the 13 January decision.
  Using the final revised records while ignoring availability gives USD 90 for the early decision
and leaks future knowledge. Filtering economic time before selecting revisions can retain
the obsolete USD 20 version in the later decision, giving USD 110. These errors survive a
superficially correct event-time cutoff. The code preserves selected source versions, rejects
duplicate revisions and checks the calculation against the small account stated here.
     A warehouse implementation can express the same order:
WITH known_versions AS (
  SELECT d.decision_id, d.decision_at, e.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY d.decision_id, e.event_id
          ORDER BY e.revision DESC) AS revision_rank
  FROM decisions d JOIN events e
    ON d.entity_id = e.entity_id
   AND e.available_at <= d.decision_at
), selected AS (
  SELECT * FROM known_versions WHERE revision_rank = 1
)
SELECT decision_id, SUM(amount) AS amount
FROM selected
WHERE NOT void
  AND occurred_at <= decision_at
  AND occurred_at > decision_at - INTERVAL ’30 days’
GROUP BY decision_id;

This query illustrates the semantics. A production query additionally preserves decisions
with no selected events, enforces source completeness, resolves currencies and permissions,
12.10. Absence is not automatically a zero                                                       71


and uses a declared authoritative revision order. The executable reference uses Python for
inspectability; the SQL is a proposed warehouse translation, not a claimed benchmark.


12.10      Absence is not automatically a zero

No matching event can mean no event occurred, the feed is incomplete, the customer was
outside coverage, or the relevant identifier was unresolved. Only the first interpretation
supports an observed zero. The reference temporal component requires a caller declaration
that the feed covers the requested window before returning an additive total. It cannot
independently verify that business assertion.
   For the full platform, observation status should distinguish at least observed value, observed
zero, not applicable, not yet available, missing within coverage and outside coverage. Trajecto-
ries retain these states together with action eligibility and outcome maturity. An account that
closes should not disappear from the original cohort simply because its subsequent product
balance is no longer stored in the active-account table.
  Measurement models can then use the appropriate pattern. A missing income document
requested only from risky applicants is not MCAR. A competitor balance observed only for
customers consenting to aggregation can require selection assumptions. A masked field supplied
by dataml should retain its recovery model and uncertainty draws. The causal consumer
decides whether the recovered quantity is an adjustment variable, outcome or scenario input
and propagates the corresponding uncertainty.


12.11      What can be automated reliably

Schema and metadata profiling can detect candidate date columns, units, key uniqueness,
foreign-key coverage, value ranges and stock-flow violations. String and representation match-
ing can suggest glossary terms. A record linker can propose probabilistic entity links. A
transformation generator can draft a join and its validation queries. These are useful assistance
tasks because their output is concrete and reviewable.
   The product should measure mapping quality by field role and consequence. Confusing
gross and net balance can alter valuation; confusing assignment and acceptance can alter
identification. A single global mapping-accuracy percentage hides that difference. A suitable
evaluation uses withheld schemas from another source system, measures precision and recall
for critical roles, and records the correction effort of a qualified data owner. Abstention on
ambiguous mappings can be preferable to a confidently wrong automatic link.
   An automatic organizer can also propose temporal precedence constraints: an offer assign-
ment precedes its receipt, and a settlement follows its underlying transaction. It should attach
the source rule and exceptions. These constraints can reduce discovery search space without
asserting that business chronology uniquely determines causality. Semantic similarity between
“deposit rate” and “funding cost” is not evidence of a causal edge or an exclusion restriction.


12.12      Entity uncertainty propagates into the study

Suppose linkage produces plausible entity assignments L1 , . . . , LM with weights wm . A scientific
analysis can repeat the study under each linkage and report how effects, fold membership and
                                     P
financial totals change. Interpreting m wm θbm as a posterior mean requires a defensible joint
72                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


linkage and outcome model; treating arbitrary match scores as posterior probabilities is not
justified.
   False merges can combine one person’s treatment with another’s outcome. Missed links
can split a household between training and evaluation folds. Both can produce bias beyond
ordinary missing-data variance. A useful qualification includes controlled false merges, missed
links and changes in connected-component size. The report should reveal whether a result
depends on a few uncertain high-value links.
   Deterministic authoritative identifiers are preferable where available, but they also change
through mergers, account migrations and legal restructuring. The entity service must preserve
historical identity and effective relationships rather than rewriting all past records to the
current organization chart. For a bank-firm credit-supply study, current group consolidation
can otherwise leak information or change the unit of analysis retrospectively.


12.13      Physical execution and access boundaries
Canonical semantics need not imply a central copy of every transaction. The platform
can publish approved views over existing warehouses, use columnar snapshots for bounded
studies and execute locally within legal entities. A catalogue identifies dataset owner, schema,
permitted purpose, retention and lineage. A study records the authorized snapshot reference
and columns used, with access checks enforced by the deployment environment.
   Large transformations should push filters and projections toward storage, partition by
useful entity/date keys and avoid materializing every lag for every possible study. Temporal
feature caches need keys that include source revision, availability rule, entity mapping, window,
currency and transformation version. A cache keyed only by feature name and event date can
return a value unavailable at the decision.
  Derived features also have publication latency. Even if all raw inputs existed by noon,
a feature generated in an overnight job was not available to a noon decision unless that
computation could actually have run then. Retrospective scientific adjustment and operational
policy information are different uses. Their admissible data views should be explicit.


12.14      Acceptance is a reconstructed account
The strongest data test is a small account reconstructed from independent source entries,
including late arrivals, reversals, ownership changes and internal transfers. The resulting
feature and outcome totals should be explained in business terms. Passing a dataframe schema
alone cannot establish that the chosen records describe the intended economic object.
   The reference component returns selected event revisions and a content hash, demonstrating
this principle for a narrow additive feature. It is not a production ingestion engine or automatic
semantic classifier. The proposed next implementation adds warehouse adapters, completeness
attestations, entity-version references and outcome-component reconciliation while retaining
that reconstructible small-account test.
Chapter 13

Open-source software and build
decisions

13.1     What was assessed

The census covers 44 projects as observed on 7 October 2026. Saved records include official
repository metadata, primary documentation and licenses, available package metadata, selected
API source and content hashes. The matrix is a source assessment, not an executed comparative
benchmark. An observed last push is not a maintenance guarantee, and monorepo activity
need not describe a particular submodule.
   The accompanying JSON records retain package versions and release dates where retrieved.
Some GitHub requests were rate-limited; CausalNex’s repository endpoint was unavailable. A
missing response is not evidence that a repository is archived. Where a commit identifier was
retrieved, it is recorded separately from mutable-branch document hashes rather than asserted
to pin files that were fetched independently.



13.2     Estimation and econometrics

DoWhy’s useful contribution is separation of modeling, identification, estimation and refutation
(Sharma and Kiciman, 2020; py-why contributors, 2026b). The inspected identify_effect
source accepts an identification method and returns an estimand object. The proposed wrapper
must preserve that object and unresolved identification status through fitting. Refutations
stress assumptions or estimators; passing them is not proof.
   EconML offers heterogeneous-effect estimators, DML, forests, IV and panel DynamicDML
(py-why contributors, 2026c). The inspected dynamic implementation uses group/period
structure and recursively adjusts future effects. The inspected implementation requires equal
trajectory lengths and treats within-group occurrence order as chronological; its splitting
keeps groups intact. The adapter must validate these restrictions before calling it, including
the treatment of irregular visits and incomplete histories. DoubleML provides transparent
orthogonal-score estimation and common inference operations (Bach et al., 2022; DoubleML
contributors, 2026). Its documentation supports model-specific nuisance estimation and cluster-
aware data structures; the attempted direct cluster source path returned 404, so no claim here
rests on inspecting that missing file.
   CausalML is a useful marketing challenger, while grf provides honest forest-based estimation,
including causal and instrumental settings (uber contributors, 2026; grf-labs contributors,

                                              73
74                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


2026). They should be compared on the same population, target and evaluation design. A
package’s uplift terminology is not evidence that historical assignment is unconfounded.
   For econometric baselines, linearmodels provides panel, IV and system regression; Py-
Fixest and R fixest provide efficient fixed-effects estimation (bashtage contributors, 2026;
py-econometrics contributors, 2026; lrberge contributors, 2026). Current PyFixest documenta-
tion also lists event-study and robust-covariance capabilities. Faster fixed effects do not repair
a misspecified heterogeneous-treatment target. Do not infer dynamic-panel GMM support
simply from the word panel. The dedicated pydynpd package documents difference and system
GMM, corrected two-step errors, serial-correlation and overidentification tests, and collapsed
instruments (dazhwu contributors, 2026). It is a more appropriate comparator for that task.
Automated model search must not be interpreted as validation of moment restrictions.
   Use R did as a reference for group-time ATT, HonestDiD for trend sensitivity, synthdid for
its supported synthetic-DiD design, and gsynth for interactive-factor comparisons (bcallaway11
contributors, 2026; asheshrambachan contributors, 2026; synth-inference contributors, 2026;
xuyiqing contributors, 2026). CausalImpact and CausalPy provide aggregate time-series and
Bayesian quasi-experimental alternatives (google contributors, 2026; pymc-labs contributors,
2026). Retain R adapters where scientific comparators are strongest rather than requiring
premature Python reimplementation.
   Longitudinal estimation also has established implementations. lmtp supports modified
treatment policies, targeted estimation, sequential DR and competing-risk outcomes; ltmle im-
plements treatment/censoring-specific means and marginal structural models (nt-williams con-
tributors, 2026; joshuaschwab contributors, 2026). gfoRmula supplies parametric g-computation
for time-varying treatments and several outcome types (CausalInference contributors, 2026).
Python zEpid provides weighting, g-formula, AIPW and TMLE tools (pzivich contributors,
2026). These should be scientific comparators before internal reimplementation. Their sup-
ported interventions, node ordering, censoring behavior and uncertainty need adapter-specific
qualification. zEpid’s observed last repository push was May 2023; compatibility is untested
here.



13.3     Discovery and latent decisions

Tigramite is the primary temporal-discovery candidate: its inspected run_pcmciplus API
exposes lag limits, link assumptions, conditioning controls and multiplicity options (jakobrunge
contributors, 2026). Causal-learn offers constraint, score and functional methods (Zheng
et al., 2024; py-why contributors, 2026a). Tetrad supplies an independent Java ecosystem
for comparison (cmu-phil contributors, 2026). Causica’s joint graph and structural-model
learning, gCastle, DAGMA and NOTEARS are research comparators (microsoft contributors,
2026; huawei-noah contributors, 2026; kevinsbello contributors, 2026; xunzheng contributors,
2026). Their fitted graph distributions or exact acyclicity constraints do not remove causal
assumptions.
   d3rlpy offers offline policy-learning implementations; SCOPE-RL offers evaluation and policy
selection; OBP addresses contextual-bandit evaluation (takuseno contributors, 2026; hakuhodo-
technologies contributors, 2026; st-tech contributors, 2026). None should be advertised as a
generic solution to hidden-confounded bank histories. SCOPE-RL and OBP had observed last
repository pushes in March and June 2024 respectively; dependency qualification and support
planning matter.
  pomdp_py and POMDPs.jl provide modeling/planning ecosystems (h2r contributors, 2026;
JuliaPOMDP contributors, 2026). Their role is distinct from parameter identification. Dy-
13.4. Data and execution                                                                     75


namax provides state-space inference and learning, while PyMC and NumPyro support
probabilistic model estimation (probml contributors, 2026; pymc-devs contributors, 2026; pyro-
ppl contributors, 2026). These are appropriate reference engines for a controlled latent-model
benchmark. Existing BayesFilter components may also be reusable, subject to the integration
qualification.


13.4     Data and execution
DuckDB is a strong local reference engine for SQL transformations and auditable small-to-
medium studies; Polars provides columnar dataframe execution; Ray can distribute independent
workloads (duckdb contributors, 2026; pola-rs contributors, 2026; ray-project contributors,
2026). Their selection should follow profiling, not an assumption that every study needs a
cluster. Catalog, lineage, feature and validation tools supply the foundations described in
Chapter 12.


13.5     Licensing and dependency economics
The inspected EconML license is MIT and CausalML is Apache-2.0 despite ambiguous reposi-
tory API license fields. DoubleML is BSD-3-Clause and linearmodels uses NCSA. PyFixest
is MIT. R fixest and did declare GPL-3; Tigramite, grf and Tetrad have GPL-3 licensing.
HonestDiD and gsynth declare MIT; synthdid is BSD-3-Clause. lmtp’s DESCRIPTION and
actual license text specify AGPL-3, despite a GPL-3 badge in its README. Use the license text
when qualifying the dependency. ltmle and gfoRmula declare GPL-2 and GPL-3 respectively;
zEpid and pydynpd use MIT.
   These observations affect distribution, integration and procurement. A separate process or
service does not automatically settle copyleft obligations. The product’s distribution model,
modifications, dependency tree and license texts require legal review at productization. No
package should be excluded solely because a metadata service failed to classify its license, nor
assumed permissive without the actual terms.


13.6     Choose by a scientific task, not a package ranking
The relevant unit of comparison is a complete estimand and design. Consider four requests
that an interface might label as a treatment effect: the population ATE of an assigned offer, a
variance-weighted partially linear coefficient, a group-time ATT following a branch rollout,
and a value contrast between eight-decision policies. These objects have different populations
and weighting. A wrapper that accepts the first available effect method and returns its array
can silently substitute one for another.
   For a static confounded offer, DoWhy can carry an explicit graph and identification record,
DoubleML can expose a declared orthogonal score, EconML can estimate heterogeneity under
the supported model, and grf can provide a forest-based challenger. They play complementary
roles (py-why contributors, 2026b; DoubleML contributors, 2026; py-why contributors, 2026c;
grf-labs contributors, 2026). The bank-specific layer still owns treatment versions, eligible
population, cost conversion and the covariance of the final policy contrast. Its evaluation
should compare the same nuisance information and held-out units. Giving a flexible method
more features or future observations would confound the software comparison.
  For the deposit rollout in Chapter 9, R did is the principal group-time reference, while
76                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


fixed-effects packages reproduce an informative but potentially inappropriate TWFE baseline.
HonestDiD investigates departures from trend restrictions; an imputation estimator offers
another aggregation route (bcallaway11 contributors, 2026; asheshrambachan contributors,
2026; Borusyak et al., 2024). These are not votes to average indiscriminately. Differences
should be explained by comparison groups, target weights, support, functional restrictions and
inference. A faster absorbed regression does not resolve which post-treatment cells belong in
the causal target.
   For repeated assistance, gfoRmula, ltmle and lmtp provide distinct constructions (CausalIn-
ference contributors, 2026; joshuaschwab contributors, 2026; nt-williams contributors, 2026).
A forward simulator requires the conditional evolution of time-varying measurements; a tar-
geted or sequential-regression method can require continuation regressions without a complete
generative environment. Modified-treatment-policy support in lmtp is particularly relevant for
continuous dose changes, but does not make an arbitrary contractual restructuring a supported
shift. The wrapper must inspect the intervention definition and loss/censoring nodes before
translating a banking request.
  The controlled latent-state study needs a different composition. Dynamax or a probabilistic
programming engine can supply estimation infrastructure; a POMDP planning ecosystem can
consume the fitted environment (probml contributors, 2026; pymc-devs contributors, 2026;
pyro-ppl contributors, 2026; JuliaPOMDP contributors, 2026; h2r contributors, 2026). The
bridge between them must preserve action selection, reward timing, policy information and
parameter uncertainty. A planning demo with known transitions does not establish that its
upstream banking likelihood is correct or causally identified.




13.7     An adapter qualification is a scientific translation

Each adapter should publish a capability declaration: supported estimand, intervention
type, outcome/censoring model, panel shape, fold interface, sample weights, cluster design,
uncertainty method and software version. Unsupported combinations should fail before fitting.
For example, a trajectory adapter cannot quietly sort by the current account identifier if the
method interprets input order as calendar order.
   Qualification begins with exact or independently reconstructed cases. For a group-time
estimator, verify the same cohort/time cells and aggregation weights. For sequential evaluation,
verify terminal rewards, discounting and cumulative ratios against short-path enumeration.
For an HMM, compare marginalized likelihood and expected counts. For discovery, verify
endpoint marks and lag conventions through serialization. A round trip that turns a circle
endpoint into an arrow is a substantive defect even if the adjacency matrix is unchanged.
   Next compare supported synthetic mechanisms over repeated samples, with appropriate
bias, coverage and failure metrics. A fixed numerical tolerance is suitable for an exact linear
calculation but generally inappropriate for two stochastic nonconvex fits. Their objective,
initialization, termination, label alignment and decision-value differences must be examined.
Package reference agreement is necessary evidence of translation; it does not prove the
maintained model describes the bank.
   Finally, record operational behavior: memory, serialization, random-state control, missing-
value conventions, interrupts and upgrade differences. The software bill of materials and
environment lock must match the executed adapter. A license snapshot and repository HEAD
retrieved on the same day do not establish that independently fetched mutable files came from
that exact commit. A qualified build must retrieve its source at a specific immutable revision.
13.8. Where a shared library should build its own code                                        77


13.8      Where a shared library should build its own code
The bank has reasons to own temporal reconstruction and financial reconciliation: these
operations depend on its action logs, legal ownership, revision systems and funds-transfer
pricing. It also has reasons to own score contracts and inference orchestration, because those
connect estimators to the original population and common shocks. The supplied components
in Chapter 15 make two such boundaries concrete without claiming a complete platform.
   By contrast, reimplementing every forest, optimizer, panel estimator and graph search
would create a large validation and maintenance obligation with limited differentiation. Thin
adapters allow established algorithms to remain identifiable. The scientific layer should export
intermediate quantities needed for independent checks, rather than hiding all methods behind
a proprietary success score.
   There are cases for internal reference implementations. The finite-state controlled HMM in
this proposal is small enough that its likelihood and EM updates can be audited directly. It is a
useful comparator for a future accelerated engine. A compact orthogonal score implementation
can verify normalization and financial contrasts. Such references should remain deliberately
simple, with an explicit supported domain, rather than grow unnoticed into a second general-
purpose library.


13.9      Language boundaries and deployment choices
Python is a practical orchestration language for this workspace, but it does not determine
the best scientific implementation. R has mature panel and longitudinal comparators; Java
supplies the Tetrad ecosystem; Julia supplies a substantial POMDP interface (bcallaway11
contributors, 2026; joshuaschwab contributors, 2026; cmu-phil contributors, 2026; JuliaPOMDP
contributors, 2026). A versioned process boundary can exchange immutable columnar data
and a result manifest without changing the estimand. The method’s license, runtime support
and error conventions remain part of qualification.
   An in-process adapter has lower transfer overhead and easier interactive use, but couples
dependency resolution and failure modes. A worker process can isolate numerical and language
environments, at the cost of data serialization, deployment complexity and duplicated memory.
A service boundary adds scheduling and access controls but does not automatically solve
licensing or scientific compatibility. Choose after measuring the actual workload and reviewing
the distribution arrangement.
  For large histories, DuckDB or the bank’s warehouse should construct partitioned snapshots;
Polars can support local transformations; Ray can schedule sufficiently independent fits (duckdb
contributors, 2026; pola-rs contributors, 2026; ray-project contributors, 2026). The independent
units, common date shocks and folds are declared before that scheduling decision. Moving row
partitions among workers must not redefine a cross-fitting scheme.

13.11      Recommended construction stack
Begin all three scientific workspaces with a common temporal and evidence layer. Use
DuckDB and schema validation as local references and integrate the bank’s existing catalog.
Qualify a small effect/panel path using DoWhy where graph-based identification is appropriate,
DoubleML/EconML for supported effect tasks, PyFixest/linearmodels for econometric baselines
and selected R methods for direct scientific comparison.
   In the same first program, build the trajectory/score interface for longitudinal methods; the
finite-state latent-estimation interface with an independently checked likelihood; and temporal
discovery through Tigramite with a causal-learn or Tetrad comparison. Their qualification
levels differ. Research estimation and ambiguous-graph output can be useful before historical
policy value or a unique causal structure is justified. Neural challengers and distributed
execution enter when measured application requirements justify their additional cost.
   The product must build the missing connections: decision-time semantics, study compilation,
evidence exports, financial outcome ownership, dependence-aware orchestration, compatibility
checks and bank-specific workspaces. It should not attempt to build a new database, general
enterprise catalog, universal causal discovery theorem or complete RL ecosystem.
Chapter 14

Architecture, interfaces and
repository reuse

14.1      One scientific core, several applications
The architecture separates data access, study semantics, estimation and use. The same
immutable study definition should drive a notebook, a scheduled service and the standalone
workbench. Estimator adapters return typed results; they do not directly approve customer
actions. A result can be computationally complete while scientifically unsupported.

                                                                           Study compiler
          Bank systems              Temporal and entity layer
                                                                            estimand, as-
    catalog and event history       snapshots, masks, lineage
                                                                          sumptions, folds


        Workbench and                     Evidence store                  Method adapters
          sibling apps                    scores, diagnos-                 effects, panels,
   decision reports and APIs               tics, versions                 policies, graphs

Figure 14.1: Proposed architecture. Estimands, assumptions and lineage accompany results.

   The compiler checks required fields, intervention/population compatibility, temporal avail-
ability, method support, dependence and action overlap. Mechanical checks coexist with
documented scientific judgments. The execution layer schedules fold fits, scores, covariance
aggregation and diagnostics. The evidence store preserves data hashes, code/dependency
versions, seeds, configuration, assumption records and reports. Large data and models remain
in approved storage, referenced by authorized metadata.


14.2      Versioned public objects
The supplied version 0.1.0 contracts define Study, TemporalEvent, EffectResult and Graph.
These are usable JSON Schemas with synthetic examples and selected semantic checks. A
separate version 0.2.0 research package implements the two narrow components in Chapter 15;
the full SDK remains proposed.
   Study records decision and assignment units, population/snapshot, horizon, treatment/com-
parator, outcome, direction, currency, identification route, assumptions and inference design.
EffectResult preserves the study hash, scientific status, evidence class, estimate or null, interval

                                                82
14.3. Proposed API behavior                                                                  83


semantics, independent-unit count, limitations and artifact references. Confidence intervals,
credible intervals and identified sets must not share an unlabeled two-number field.
   TemporalEvent distinguishes occurrence, recording, availability and decision times. Graph
preserves DAG/CPDAG/PAG type, lag and endpoint marks. Checks reject late information,
future historical measurements, missing-as-zero records, unsupported point estimates, reversed
intervals, unlabeled bounds, absent assumptions, PAG edges called DAG edges, unknown
nodes and lags outside the window.
   Further objects should include TrajectoryBatch, RecoveryEnsemble, PolicySpec, Belief-
Model, OutcomeComponents and EvidenceBundle. Their required semantics include action
masks/propensities, observation/censoring masks, state/reward timing, uncertainty draws,
policy information, cash-flow ownership and provenance. They are not already implemented
schemas.


14.3     Proposed API behavior
A proposed Python workflow is:
study = Study.from_json("study.json")
cohort = data.materialize(study.population, as_of=study.snapshot)
design = identify(study, cohort, graph=study.graph)
diagnostics = assess_support(design, cohort)
result = estimate(design, cohort, estimator="doubleml_adapter")
bundle = evidence.export(study, result, diagnostics)

These workflow names illustrate the proposed interface; they are not callable functions in this
repository. The implemented component names and actual usage are given in Chapter 15.
Proposed service calls return versioned artifacts and status rather than silently replacing
previous results.

  Proposed endpoint                                Behavior
  POST /v1/studies                                 Validate a specification
  POST /v1/studies/{id}/runs                       Accept an idempotency key
  GET /v1/runs/{id}                                Return stage and scientific status
  GET /v1/runs/{id}/evidence                       Return authorized evidence references


Data access uses approved dataset references rather than arbitrary SQL executed with service
credentials.
   Errors should identify unknown treatment versions, unavailable features, incompatible
inference, unsupported actions, absent controls, unresolved identification or numerical failure.
Retries resume deterministic checkpoints; changed inputs create a new run. Cancellation must
not publish a partial estimate as final.


14.4     Cross-repository integration
Documentation from nine local repositories was inspected and copied with hashes (Workspace
project contributors, 2026). The following are proposed interfaces, not completed integrations.
